title: Layer 2 round 1 minor collector: acquisition and derivation honesty
description: (1) SE: session-query Failed reads as 'no session' under Acquired (acquire.rs:53), contradicting Failed's store-problem contract — distinguish no-session from refusal or declare the conflation in the bootstrap doc. (2) SE+DE: the 2c arm enforces a current_layer conjunct the adopted rule table does not state (derive.rs:111) — code is defensible (a stale prior-layer pass must not flip the transition) but code and ADOPTED oracle now disagree; OPERATOR-SHAPED, see the batch note. (3) SE: the runtime vocabulary lookup in derive is a behavioral no-op with an overclaiming comment (derive.rs:57) — delete it and let the membership test carry the pin, or make non-membership observable. (4) DE: phase-2a/2b gate matching ignores GateResult.phase while 2c checks it (derive.rs:83) — align. (5) DE: display_active_milestone acquired without the schema-mandated precomputed count (folded into the parse major). Owner: software-engineer/data-engineer by item. Validator: quality-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: the session-arm refusal conflation is now a DECLARED bootstrap conflation in the module doc citing this issue — a refused session query renders the worded absence until crosslink exposes the distinction; the no-op vocabulary lookup in the derivation is replaced by a debug assertion (the release pin remains the membership test over the whole emission set). The 2c-conjunct half resolved as the #738 oracle amendment (recorded there 2026-07-22): gate records match on kind, outcome, layer, AND phase uniformly across the 2a/2b/2c arms — derive.rs's doc table and implementation now state and enforce exactly that; no fixture values changed.
